namespace ZeroPayloadCheckedRecords

/-- A proof-only checked record: no runtime field, one erased proof. -/
structure Witness : Type where
  positive : 0 < 1

/-- A Unit-bearing checked record: one runtime `Unit` field beside an erased proof. -/
structure Token : Type where
  tag : Unit
  fresh : True

/-- A plain empty record: no fields and no proofs, so it is never a checked record. -/
structure Marker : Type where

/-- A variant whose active branch carries a proof-only checked record. -/
inductive Mark : Type where
  | blank
  | marked (witness : Witness)

/-- Checked constructors: a nullary constructor is the only proof source for a `Witness`. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_constructor_mkWitness]
def mkWitness : Option Witness := some ⟨Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_constructor_mkToken]
def mkToken (tag : Unit) : Option Token := some ⟨tag, trivial⟩
/-- A refusing nullary constructor: the host's empty carrier is rejected at the boundary. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_constructor_mkAbsent]
def mkAbsent : Option Witness := none

/-- Count a checked proof-only input. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_witnessCount]
def witnessCount (value : Witness) : Nat := 1
/-- The same input site under the refusing constructor. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_absentCount]
def absentCount (value : Witness) : Nat := 0
/-- Read the unit tag of a checked token input. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_tokenTag]
def tokenTag (value : Token) : Unit := value.tag
/-- Lean produces the proof; the host receives the empty carrier. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_produceWitness]
def produceWitness : Witness := ⟨Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_produceToken]
def produceToken : Token := ⟨(), trivial⟩
/-- Containers of zero-payload results keep their length and presence. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_witnesses]
def witnesses (count : Nat) : Array Witness :=
  (List.replicate count (⟨Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : Witness)).toArray
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_maybeWitness]
def maybeWitness (present : Bool) : Option Witness :=
  if present then some ⟨Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ else none
/-- A plain empty record crosses as an ordinary copied record in both directions. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_markerCount]
def markerCount (value : Marker) : Nat := 0
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_produceMarker]
def produceMarker : Marker := Marker.mk
/-- Both variant branches remain distinct after the nested proof has been erased. -/
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_markCount]
def markCount (value : Mark) : Nat :=
  match value with
  | .blank => 0
  | .marked _ => 1
@[noinline, export lb_zero_payload_full_probe_source_produceMark]
def produceMark (active : Bool) : Mark :=
  if active then .marked ⟨Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ else .blank

end ZeroPayloadCheckedRecords
